# Scopico

> Senior technology consultancy based in Skopje, North Macedonia, serving clients in the United States, United Kingdom, and European Union.

## Services

- [Fractional CTO](https://scopico.co/services/): senior technology leadership without the full-time hire — strategy, roadmaps, build-vs-buy decisions, technical credibility.
- [Technology advisory](https://scopico.co/services/): ongoing counsel on architecture decisions, scaling, team structure, and delivery risk.
- [Solution architecture & audits](https://scopico.co/services/): architecture reviews, codebase audits, and rescue for troubled projects. Deep background in .NET, Azure, and distributed systems at scale.
- [AI-assisted development adoption](https://scopico.co/services/): help engineering teams adopt AI-assisted workflows — standards, context engineering, and guardrails.
- [Development management & SDLC improvement](https://scopico.co/services/): diagnostics and hands-on improvement of development lifecycle processes.
- [Dedicated development teams](https://scopico.co/services/): vetted developers assembled and led by Timotej Jakimovski, with architecture oversight included.
- [Custom software development](https://scopico.co/services/): end-to-end design and delivery of business software on the Microsoft stack. Lump sum against fixed, agreed requirements, or time-and-materials only within an established dedicated development team.

## Technologies

Deepest on the Microsoft stack: C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, TypeScript, Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub (Copilot, Enterprise), TFS, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, Windows Server, PowerShell. Also: Angular, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Go, MySQL, Oracle PL/SQL, Apache Cordova, Android.

## About

Founded by Timotej Jakimovski, software engineer and development lead with 13+ years of experience building enterprise software. Currently development lead on an enterprise time, cost, and vehicle-fleet management platform for a French enterprise client (.NET Core, Angular, MSSQL on Azure, load-balanced for 15,000 peak users), leading 6 developers and 2 testers across multinational remote teams.

## Working principles

- Senior-only: the person you meet is the person who does the work.
- One client per industry at a time: no conflicts of interest.
- Selective by design: every engagement is vetted before committing.

## Availability

Monday–Friday 17:30–20:00 CET, Saturdays by arrangement. Full-time offshore engagements considered.
